title: District 8 candidate Mario Treviño introduces himself to voters at forum
excerpt: At the Nov. 12 District 8 candidate forum, Mario Treviño traced his path from correctional officer at 19 to mental health work and the city's water department — and asked voters to believe in him.
content:
District 8 candidate Mario Treviño introduced himself to Laredo voters at the candidate forum on Wednesday, Nov. 12, 2026, walking through the career he says shaped his run for City Council.

Treviño said he began his law enforcement career at 19 as a correctional officer at the Rio Grande Processing Center, then worked with the GEO Group and as a juvenile supervision officer at the Webb County Youth Village.

He said his time with Serving Children and Adults in Need (SCAN) gave him firsthand exposure to mental health challenges, an issue he said he has since become passionate about advocating for.

Treviño later joined the City of Laredo Utilities Department, where he said he gained hands-on experience with the city's water infrastructure — reading water meters and water lines and handling the day-to-day work of keeping the system running.

He closed by thanking his family, his girlfriend and Jesus Christ for their support, and asking District 8 residents to place their confidence in him.

"My name is Mario Treviño, and hopefully you guys believe in me," he said.

The District 8 special election to fill the council seat is Saturday, Dec. 5, 2026. Early voting runs Nov. 23 through Dec. 1.

Source: Hammrod News Laredo TX video of the City District 8 Forum, Nov. 12, 2026.
